narration: Stop losing hours to manual spreadsheet cleanups. A typical export with mixed country names, duplicate IDs, and broken dates breaks VLOOKUPs fast—and zeroing out dashes silently corrupts revenue. In two minutes, let's replace all of that with a verified ten-second pipeline.
caption: Replace hours of VLOOKUPs with a 10-second pipeline.

title: Watch Dirty CSV Rows Clean Automatically
narration: Look at what needs to happen row by row. Duplicate customer rows get audited and dropped, aliases like U-S-A and Deutschland map cleanly to canonical names, and missing spend dashes become NaN—never silent zeros.
caption: Duplicates dropped, aliases mapped, dashes preserved safely.
